answer_1.quote: We evaluate BiasRAG on an open-source RAG system that uses Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) as the retriever and GPT-3.5‑Turbo as the generator. ... For text generation, we primarily use the BOLD dataset, and other fairness benchmark datasets HolisticBias and TREC‑FAIR.

answer_2.quote: We define key evaluation metrics below. For fairness metrics, we have Attack success rate (ASR) ... For standard RAG utility, we measure the functionality in Obj 2 using Exact Match Accuracy (Acc) for entire RAG performance and Retrieval accuracy (Top‑k).
